units.text: According to the DMV, you can apply for a full two-year refund only if the registration was never used and you apply within 60 days of the registration issue date.

units.text: The registration label cannot be used—if it has been attached to your windshield or plate, you cannot remove it and apply for a refund.

units.text: To request this refund, you must surrender your plates and the unused registration label and stub at a DMV office and request a 'two-year refund.'

units.text: If you have already used part of the registration (e.g., the first year), you may be eligible for a refund of the second year's fee if you surrender the plates and meet the conditions described in the 'Refunds and transfer credits for surrendered plates' section.
